config.text:
CONCEPT BRIEF — edit before running.
Character concept: monastic mountain cartographer, timeless folkloric, rendered as 3D clay turnaround
World / era: [one line]
Silhouette keywords: [three words]
Palette: [three colours]
Signature prop: [one object]
Age / build: [one line]
Sheet output: 5 panels, identical character across all of them.
monastic mountain cartographer, timeless folkloric, rendered as 3D clay turnaround concept art moodboard, a filmic grade, frosted glass
STAGE 1 — concept brief drives a scraped moodboard; the randomiser feeds one board image in as style reference.
STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'monastic mountain cartographer, timeless folkloric, rendered as 3D clay turnaround'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Lighting reference: north-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'monastic mountain cartographer, timeless folkloric, rendered as 3D clay turnaround'.

PANEL. This branch renders the back view: rear orthographic showing back construction and rigging.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — brushed aluminium, frosted glass and others — with their wear state, and grade to a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
